lead: Registering a `Core` class narrows `Core`'s blanket trust for that name.
body: An unregistered `Core\X::y()` is waved through by `nvs_hir::members`; once `X` is in `registry::CLASSES`, an unknown member on it is a diagnostic. Adding a class can turn a fixture that "compiled" into one that reports — which is the point, but check the fixtures that name it.
